pace.direction: actual velocity projected toward route goal; lateral speed alone does not count

pace.near_goal_boundary: distance_to_goal_m <= near_goal_distance_m selects lower reference; does not establish successful arrival
pace.effective_reference: approach_reference_speed_mps when distance_to_goal_m <= near_goal_distance_m; reference_speed_mps otherwise

pace.near_goal_exempt_diagnostic: always false; slow reference is not an exemption
pace.success_handling: successful goal-box arrival must set terminal_event and has zero pace cost

overspeed.threshold_meaning: task speed preference; not a claim about legal road speed limit
